Title: Two different records with the same name and subtitle

Issue body excerpt: We need to figure out If it is legal to have two records with the same name and subtitle as in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/3148#issuecomment-802665505. Note that programs are different. It also can happen with shortcuts. If it is legal then we have to change `UserSelectedRecord.json` logic as right now it uses `Title+Subtitle` as a key.

Latest public comment excerpt: @mykhailopylyp OK, so it's both a bug and UI issue. The path as a key may be the best solution. I would assume that users don't move their apps to different location often, so if the search weight gets reset in those cases, it should be acceptable.

comment.body:
Thanks for the report. The current issue identifies the affected behavior ("Two different records with the same name and subtitle") and the dashboard revalidation saw the public labels/comments, but it still does not contain enough current diagnostic evidence to distinguish a PowerToys code defect from environment- or configuration-specific behavior.

Please provide:
1. Numbered steps that reproduce the problem from a clean PowerToys start, including the exact PowerToys version and Windows version.
2. A fresh diagnostic archive captured immediately after reproducing it by adding a comment containing /bugreport.

Those details will let maintainers confirm the failing path for Product-PowerToys Run and decide whether this should move to a concrete fix design.
